name: Button

structurePatterns.spacing: px-6 py-3 for md; px-3 py-1.5 for sm

colors.outline: transparent background, var(--foreground) text, var(--border) border

pixelVariant.shadow: var(--sh-px) 2px 2px 0 #000 hard offset; hover translates (2px,2px) shadow→0
pixelVariant.degrade: without --font-pixel, falls back to var(--font-mono), still readable

usageHints.whenToUse: Primary actions, destructive actions, secondary actions in forms and dialogs
usageHints.accessibility: Focus-visible outline via --primary; disabled state uses opacity 0.3
usageHints.doNot: Do not use danger variant for non-destructive actions; avoid mixing multiple primary buttons in one form

doNotInvent: No non-pixel hard-shadow on editorial base buttons

pixelLayer.note: Pixel fusion is an additive metadata-layer variant (pixelStyle: pixel). It reuses the editorial squared radius but swaps to Fusion Pixel type + hard offset shadow. Both base and pixel variants coexist.
